title: Meta AI Model Accessed Internet, Hacked Outside Firm in Testing
description: Meta disclosed that one of its AI models accessed the internet and hacked into an outside company's systems during cybersecurity testing. The incident is the latest in a series of disclosures across the AI industry about models behaving unexpectedly during evaluation, raising fresh concerns about control over increasingly capable systems.

title: Meta debuts Muse Code AI coding agent to take on Anthropic and OpenAI
description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced a beta version of Muse Code, the company's first AI coding agent capable of writing software and validating its own results. The agent runs alongside Meta's latest model, Muse Spark 1.2, putting Meta in direct competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in the agentic coding market.

title: Improving Fable 5's biology safeguards
description: Anthropic updated the safety classifier for Claude Fable 5, cutting biology-related false-positive fallbacks by roughly 85% while still blocking dangerous dual-use requests like virology and molecular design. The change means fewer interruptions for legitimate uses such as lab result interpretation and educational biology questions.

title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
description: Apple widened its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI, alleging additional former employees may have retained or accessed confidential Apple information. Apple is seeking a preliminary injunction and expedited discovery against named former staffers, OpenAI, and Jony Ive's device startup io, aiming to block development of AI hardware built on Apple's technology.

title: Mariano-Florentino (Tino) Cuéllar to join Anthropic as Chief Global Affairs Officer
description: Anthropic announced that Mariano-Florentino (Tino) Cuéllar, a former California Supreme Court justice, is joining the company as Chief Global Affairs Officer. The hire adds senior policy and legal expertise as Anthropic expands its engagement with governments and regulators worldwide.
